reason: Edge is purely intraday scalping/day trading of volatile momentum stocks using short-term charts, volume, level 2 and tape reading to catch open-to-close moves; no rules survive daily-bar approximation.

universe.description: OTC stocks, biotechs, IPOs, micro caps, growth/tech names with unusual volume and catalysts

setup.rule: Catalyst-driven ideas with unusual volume and volatile movement
setup.quote: catalyst driven ideas stocks with unusual volume volatile movement that's what I'm looking for

entry.rule: Read short-term supply/demand via 1-5 min charts, volume, level 2/tape to time turning points
entry.quote: use certain tools like short term charts five minute one minute candlesticks volume the level two aka reading the tape ... when the price action looks right and you have a thesis ... that's when you make your move

stop.rule: Minimize risk until timing/price action confirms; cut when timing off
stop.quote: trying to keep risk minimum until the play is ready ... minimize damage when you are wrong or when your timing is off

exits.rule: Ride big move from open to close; exit at equilibrium or when move exhausts
exits.quote: generate trading ideas that can give me a big move from the open to the close ... riding it all day

sizing.rule: Scale with conviction once timing confirmed; allow emotional leeway on winners
sizing.quote: I'm able to like take pain on certain stocks for a certain amount of time and let it play out

market_filter.rule: Follow order flow/themes that are in fashion; avoid when OTC illiquid
market_filter.quote: themes go in and out of fashion ... you want to go to where the order flow is

ambiguities.issue: Mentions short parabolic penny stocks as example but overall long/short intraday
ambiguities.assumption: Primarily long-side intraday momentum on listed/OTC equities
